key_invariants: expired lease may be reacquired only after recovery validation
stale lease epochs cannot write state or attempt effects
unfinished task switch requires current-user consent

hypothesis: A single persistent UnifiedDB lease with monotonic fencing epoch plus one-host physical exclusion can implement one-spawn-at-a-time Frank semantics without making the token/client/peer AI part of SELF.
strongest_counterhypotheses: A simple Linux flock may dominate a persistent lease for one-host mutual exclusion.
Time-based expiry can incorrectly transfer Frank while an old execution is still live or while recovery has not been validated.
A semantic presence lease may serialize holders but still allow concurrent executions from the same holder unless execution identity is separately bounded.
Presence fencing that stops heartbeat/release may still fail to fence stale effects unless lease epoch is checked at the trusted effect boundary.

external_primary_evidence.finding: SQLite serializes write transactions; BEGIN IMMEDIATE begins a write transaction immediately. Suitable for short lease CAS, not a long cognitive transaction.
flock provides advisory file locking and releases the lock with the underlying open-file-description lifetime; useful as one-host physical exclusion but not semantic identity/authority.
409 Conflict is an ordinary HTTP mapping compatible with FRANK_BUSY as a current-resource-state conflict; semantic FRANK_BUSY remains authoritative.

duplicate_work_control.reason: Canonical V15 presence implementation landed on target main while isolated candidate was being built; swarm law requires reuse rather than a second runtime authority.

current_target_evidence.finding: Canonical V15 FrankPresenceRuntime and one singleton presence lease landed.
Regression covers expired old-holder mutation rejection but still expects an unrelated successor to auto-acquire after wall-clock expiry.
One-host Linux physical execution gate adds full-window flock before V15 semantic acquisition; it explicitly remains advisory/non-semantic and requires all admitted execution paths to cooperate.

material_negative_result.finding: Canonical FrankPresenceRuntime.acquire currently allows EXPIRED_TAKEOVER from wall-clock expiry without an explicit recovery-validation receipt/capability. This is weaker than the owner-fixed rule lease_expired_and_recovery_validated.
material_negative_result.nuance_after_physical_gate: The full-window flock can provide strong one-host no-live-cooperating-holder evidence when it is the sole admitted execution path, but raw V15 acquire remains a semantic bypass and the physical proof is not yet bound as a recovery-validation receipt.

required_integration: exactly one admitted production execution entry path
physical exclusion proof must not become a second semantic authority
expiry cannot by itself mint takeover authority
recovery/no-current-holder validation must be bound to an auditable epoch transition before fresh acquisition
same-holder requests still require execution-level serialization/idempotency
current lease epoch must fence trusted effect reservation/attempt/commit paths
BUSY/yield/handoff layers must preserve the single canonical presence authority
architecture_delta.rollback: Keep V15 presence + existing physical gate unchanged until discriminators prove a narrower repair; never merge the closed duplicate PR 133 runtime.

PR 146 interactive idle handoff before autonomous presence
live_swarm_coordination.decision: Do not start another competing single-spawn runtime patch while these lanes are active; consume their receipts and converge on one admitted authority path.
